text:
Northstar Finishes
PROPOSAL TOTAL $6,250.00
Scuff-sand glossy surfaces, fill nail holes, caulk open joints, and spot-prime repaired areas. Apply two finish coats to walls. Cover floors and fixed furnishings with drop cloths and plastic. Final cleanup included. Three-year labor warranty.

Freshline Painting
ESTIMATE TOTAL $3,800.00
Paint walls with one finish coat. Drywall repair, if needed, will be priced separately. Ceilings excluded. Cleanup included.

Coastal Coatings
QUOTE TOTAL $5,100.00
Walls receive two coats of Sherwin-Williams Duration Home eggshell. Semi-gloss finish on trim and doors. Lead testing and abatement are not included.
